base_amount_policy.no_fallback: Never infer, discover, or fall back to $50.00 or any broker/account default base amount. The base is fixed at exactly $2.00.

risk_guard.description: Dynamic risk guard. A rolling 30-day cash-burn rate is tracked for visibility. When capital deployed in any trailing 7-day window exceeds kill_switch_7d_deploy_fraction (40%) of monthly_cash_allocation_usd, the graded ladder is capped at 1x: the strategy keeps buying dips at the base amount but stops scaling up until the 7-day window rolls back under the threshold. Deployment is counted only from scheduled-live afternoon evidence (run_origin='scheduled', manual_run=false, timestamp at/after 2:30 PM ET); manual and other streams are excluded. See docs/risk_management.md and dca_risk.py.

budget_tiers.name: stress
budget_tiers.note: Usable only to the extent prior unused weekly rollover reserve is available.

selection_rule: Pick the highest tier triggered by EITHER planned spend or the count of 3x-or-greater signals. A 3x-or-greater signal is a buy candidate whose ladder multiplier is >= 3.0.
allocation_priority: Prioritize allocations by higher multiplier first, then larger percent drop, then ticker (alphabetical) for a deterministic tie-break. Flag any capped tickers.

robinhood.note: Only execution broker/account for live and manual runs.

alpaca.note: Read-only validation and account context only; never execution unless explicitly changed later.

finance.note: Read-only market-data/validation context only; never execution.

yahoo.note: Read-only market-data/validation context only; never execution.

market_data_source_policy.summary: The Finance connector is the PRIMARY market-data source. Alpaca and Robinhood provide validation / context. Yahoo Finance through yfinance is a FALLBACK ONLY, used when the Finance connector data is unavailable, stale, incomplete, or unresolved. Fallback data must be labeled as fallback and must NOT weaken confidence, spread, trend, top-up, budget, whitelist, buy-only, regular-hours-only, or any safety rule. Robinhood remains the only execution broker.
market_data_source_policy.gfuz_exception: GFUZ may use Robinhood as its PRIMARY source when the Finance connector cannot resolve it (see config/tickers.json:special_handling.GFUZ).

safety_policy: No sells, options, crypto, margin changes, account modifications, or order cancellations unless explicitly requested later. Buys only, regular market hours only, one strategy order per ticker per stream per day.

execution_authorization_policy.description: As approved Fri Jul 10 2026 11:20 AM ET, scheduled live DCA tasks are pre-authorized to auto-place qualifying buys within all caps and circuit breakers WITHOUT per-order human confirmation.

scheduled_tasks.placement_precondition: May call place_equity_order directly ONLY after every internal validation, signal, budget, spread, confidence/trend, and top-up check passes.
scheduled_tasks.note: Scheduled live tasks must NOT request per-order confirmation and must NOT call Robinhood review_equity_order (which forces a preview + confirmation).

manual_tasks.note: Manual / ad hoc runs still use the review + confirmation path before any placement.

circuit_breakers.max_per_order_note: 5x * $2 base = $10 is the absolute per-order ceiling across all live streams.
skip_conditions: skip if the bid/ask spread is too wide
skip if the intraday trend cannot be validated down (flag manual_review_candidate instead of buying)
skip a top-up if the current price is not strictly below the prior same-day buy reference price
skip if it would exceed the max per-order $10 ceiling
skip if it would exceed the selected daily or weekly cap
skip if it would exceed available buying power
skip any ticker not on the active whitelist
skip if a strategy order for that ticker was already placed in this stream today

order_rules.requires_review_before_submit: Manual runs: review_equity_order must pass first. Scheduled live runs are pre-authorized (see execution_authorization_policy) and call place_equity_order directly after all internal checks pass, without review_equity_order.

hard_limits: Never exceed the max per-order $10 ceiling, the selected daily cap, the selected weekly cap, or available buying power. Caps are absolute ceilings; when a rule and an order conflict, the order is skipped.
